patch_list: Blocks ads that appear when opening XRecorder.
Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and advertising ID permissions.
Blocks subscription token uploads. Server-side entitlements stay unchanged.
Blocks Firebase Remote Config overrides for ads and the server address.
Unlocks local Pro tools and ad-free mode. AI and credits still require server validation. Known issue: the Edit tab closed during testing on a Galaxy A15.
